+

+
+# We use a global to capture scopes since we can't easily return them from deep dependencies
+captured_scopes = {}
+
+async def dep_1(security_scopes: SecurityScopes):
+    captured_scopes["dep_1"] = security_scopes.scopes
+    return "dep_1"
+

+    captured_scopes["dep_2"] = security_scopes.scopes
+    return "dep_2"
+

+async def root(d2 = Security(dep_2, scopes=["scope2"])):
+    return d2
+
+client = TestClient(app)
+

+    global captured_scopes
+    captured_scopes = {}
